snippet.title: Sort The Toys - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sort The Toys on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5175160/Sort_The_Toys/

Sort The Toys is a relaxing organizing simulator where you place over 3,400 toys onto their designated shelves. Play at your own pace, unlock helpful skills, and enjoy the satisfying process of bringing complete order to a cluttered toy store.

#game #trailer #indiegame #cozy
